summary: Rexford Industrial Realty, Inc. reported on Form 8-K that its operating partnership and certain subsidiaries completed the disposition of a 22-property industrial portfolio to an affiliate of EQT Real Estate on September 16, 2026, under an August 13, 2026 purchase agreement. Aggregate purchase price was approximately $1.2 billion before customary credits, prorations and closing adjustments. Net proceeds are earmarked for general corporate purposes, including debt repayment, common stock repurchases, and internal repositioning and development projects. No advisor, premium, or per-share terms were disclosed. Watch for use-of-proceeds deployment, buyback pace, and cap-rate read-through for industrial REIT pricing.
